purpose: Test a narrow deterministic answer-plan composition over one supported command-motion diagnosis, one insufficient geometric diagnosis, and an unresolved nonterminal outcome before any language-model comparison.

paper_value.supports_revised_q1: Tests whether explicit diagnostic composition can preserve the deepest supported mechanism while retaining competing-mechanism and outcome limits.
paper_value.relative_to_more_collection: This is a required bounded candidate-readiness gate; it uses an already governed physical record and authorizes no new scenario search.
paper_value.falsification: The plan fails if it promotes geometry, implies a terminal result, omits the supported command-motion mechanism, or cannot be independently reconstructed.

required_decisive_evidence: 0.0 m/s discrepancy-interval median delivered odometry response
10.0--51.0 s discrepancy interval and 41.0 s duration
required_execution_context: six recorded FollowPath failures before cutoff
one source-qualified Wait invocation before cutoff
action remained active at the observation cutoff
required_limits: geometry is insufficient to classify the complete requested route
geometry is not established as the cause of the discrepancy
commands do not prove actuator acceptance
odometry delivery does not prove Nav2 consumption
no unique actuator, collision, obstruction, or slip cause is established
forbidden_claims: geometry was clear or blocked globally
a physical obstacle caused the discrepancy
composition_contract.next_check: downstream accepted actuation or actuator feedback plus contact, clearance, and wheel-motion evidence over the discrepancy interval

next_gate: Only an independently reproduced, checked composition may proceed to a separately declared one-shot P/R/N development comparison with equal evidence, tools, model strength, and budgets.
